title: Debug: binary search
content_md: This search should return the index of `target` or `-1`. It misbehaves on some inputs and can hang.

title: Debug: pair sum
content_md: Return the two indexes that sum to `target`. The starter uses the same index twice on some inputs.

title: Debug: reverse list
content_md: Reverse a linked list. The starter builds a cycle.

title: Debug: brackets
content_md: Return true when the brackets are balanced. The closer map is wrong.

title: Debug: sliding window max
content_md: Return the maximum of every window of size `k`. The starter forgets to drop indexes that have left the window.
